label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Drivers Christmas breakfast

Hi Rhonda, its Gary from the bus garage again. I know its early but I wanted to get our Christmas breakfast on the books with you. We do it every year at your place and we'd like to do it again. Saturday Dec 19, back room, 7am same as always. If the 19th is no good for you then the 12th would work for us. Can you let me know which one you can do?

Looks like 24 of us this year, and that counts Earl and his wife Carol. Dwayne got the sign up sheet off the board so I think that's right but I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you ask so you're not guessing on food.

Couple things about the group this year. Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip, so he needs to come in the side door with no steps. Can you make sure that door is open and somebody can give him a hand if he needs it? Also Patsy can't do eggs anymore. She said no eggs, oatmeal, pancakes, or whatever. Is there something else she can get, maybe fruit or a biscuit or something off the menu? I don't want her sitting there watching everybody eat.

Now the coffee. I remember last year the urn quit on you around 8:15 and you felt bad about it. I told everybody it wasn't your fault, it happens. Could you have a backup pot ready this time, just in case? I'm asking nice, not trying to give you a hard time. We're a bunch of drivers and we like our coffee.

This year is kind of a big one for us. Earl is retiring. He's drove for 31 years and his last day is the 18th, the day before we'd be there. He don't know we're doing anything for him, so please keep it quiet if he calls or comes in. Carol said he'd be embarrassed by a big speech but he'd love it if the guys did something. He loves your cinnamon rolls. I mean loves them. I always say they're better than any cake.

That's kind of what I wanted to ask you. Would it be better to get a cake from Sugarcreek Bakery or just do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle in it? I'm leaning toward the cinnamon rolls since its Earl, but I wanted your opinion since it's your kitchen. Whatever you think works.

On the price, $11 a head was fair last time and its fine if its up a little. I know everything's gone up. Same setup as before with the family style eggs and potatoes and biscuits and gravy, and meats off the menu? Separate checks again too, that worked good last time.

Let me know what you think and we'll go from there. Thanks Rhonda.

Gary Hollins

reasons: It never actually asks Rhonda for this year's per-person price; it only says $11 was fair last year and a little more is fine.
